name: iCHO Trend CCIDualOnMA Filter
summary: A multi-indicator trend-following EA that combines Chaikin Oscillator (iCHO) for money flow direction with dual CCI indicators for momentum confirmation, filtered through a Moving Average to determine the prevailing trend. It enters long positions when all indicators align bullish and short positions when all align bearish, providing a layered signal confirmation system.
summary_zh: 一个多指标趋势跟踪EA，结合蔡金振荡器(iCHO)判断资金流向，双CCI指标确认动量，并通过移动均线过滤趋势方向。当所有指标方向一致时开仓，形成多层信号确认体系。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于多指标协同确认的趋势跟踪系统，使用蔡金振荡器(iCHO)衡量资金的流入流出方向作为主信号。双CCI指标（快周期和慢周期）分别捕捉短期和中期动量变化，两个CCI必须同向才确认入场，避免单一动量指标的误判。移动均线作为趋势过滤器，价格必须在MA上方才允许做多，在MA下方才允许做空，确保交易方向与主趋势一致。仓位管理方面，从文件名来看没有明显的马丁格尔或网格特征，应采用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算。出场条件可能依赖反向信号或固定止损止盈，当任一核心指标反转时可能触发平仓。资金管理通过多层指标过滤降低虚假信号概率，但多指标系统在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假交叉信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a multi-indicator confluence trend-following system that uses the Chaikin Oscillator (iCHO) to measure money flow direction as the primary signal. The dual CCI indicators (fast and slow periods) capture short-term and medium-term momentum shifts respectively, requiring both to align in the same direction before confirming entry, which avoids false signals from a single momentum indicator. The Moving Average acts as a trend filter — long positions are only permitted when price is above the MA and short positions only when below, ensuring trade direction aligns with the prevailing trend. Position sizing appears to use fixed lots or equity-based calculation without Martingale or grid characteristics based on the naming convention. Exit conditions likely depend on reverse signals from any core indicator or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels, with position closure triggered when any key indicator reverses direction. Money management reduces false signal probability through multi-layer indicator filtering, though multi-indicator systems can generate frequent whipsaw signals in ranging markets.

parameters.description_en: Moving average period for trend direction

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points per level, 0 for none

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points per level

pros: 多指标协同确认大幅降低虚假信号概率，三层过滤机制提供高质量入场
蔡金振荡器基于成交量的资金流向分析比纯价格指标更具前瞻性
双CCI设计（快慢周期）兼顾短期动量和中期趋势确认，避免单一周期误判
移动均线趋势过滤确保交易方向与主趋势一致，减少逆势交易
系统化规则明确，无主观判断空间，适合自动化执行
pros_en: Multi-indicator confluence significantly reduces false signals with three-layer filtering for high-quality entries
Chaikin Oscillator's volume-based money flow analysis provides more forward-looking signals than pure price indicators
Dual CCI design (fast and slow periods) balances short-term momentum and medium-term trend confirmation, avoiding single-period misjudgment
Moving average trend filter ensures trade direction aligns with the main trend, reducing counter-trend trades
Systematic rules are well-defined with no subjective judgment, suitable for automated execution
cons: 多指标协同在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假交叉信号，导致连续止损
蔡金振荡器依赖成交量数据，在外汇市场成交量数据质量较差可能影响信号可靠性
缺乏明确的止损止盈机制描述，默认值可能为零，存在风险敞口问题
多指标滞后性叠加可能导致入场过晚，错过趋势初段的大部分利润
参数过多可能导致过拟合风险，在不同市场环境下需要大量优化调整
cons_en: Multi-indicator confluence tends to generate frequent whipsaw signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive stop-losses
Chaikin Oscillator relies on volume data which is of poor quality in forex markets, potentially affecting signal reliability
Lack of explicit stop-loss and take-profit mechanism descriptions with default values possibly zero, creating risk exposure issues
Cumulative lag from multiple indicators may cause late entries, missing most of the early trend profit
Excessive parameters create overfitting risk, requiring extensive optimization across different market conditions
improvements: 增加市场状态识别模块（如ATR或ADX），在震荡行情中自动降低仓位或暂停交易
添加动态止损机制（如基于ATR的追踪止损），替代固定的止损止盈设置
增加成交量质量检查机制，在成交量数据不可靠时降级蔡金振荡器的权重
improvements_en: Add market regime detection module (e.g., ATR or ADX) to automatically reduce position size or pause trading during ranging markets
Implement dynamic stop-loss mechanism (e.g., ATR-based trailing stop) to replace fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings
Add volume data quality check mechanism to downgrade Chaikin Oscillator weight when volume data is unreliable

risk_points: 多指标系统在震荡市中可能频繁开平仓导致连续亏损
蔡金振荡器在外汇市场受限于成交量数据质量可能产生错误信号
默认止损止盈可能为零，缺乏明确的风控参数存在无限亏损风险
risk_points_en: Multi-indicator system may open and close positions frequently in ranging markets causing consecutive losses
Chaikin Oscillator limited by volume data quality in forex markets may produce incorrect signals
Default stop-loss and take-profit values may be zero, lacking explicit risk control parameters creates unlimited loss risk

summary_en: A multi-indicator trend-following EA that combines Chaikin Oscillator (iCHO) for money flow direction with dual CCI indicators for momentum confirmation, filtered through a Moving Average to determine the prevailing trend. It enters long positions when all indicators align bullish and short positions when all align bearish, providing a layered signal confirmation system.
